Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 3. Service & Support Availability of Service Centres: Bidder/OEM must have a Functional Service Centre in the State of each Consignee's Location in case of carry-in warranty. (Not applicable in case of goods having on-site warranty). If service center is not already there at the time of bidding, successful bidder / OEM shall have to establish one within 30 days of award of contract. Payment shall be released only after submission of documentary evidence of having Functional Service Centre. 4. Certificates ISO 9001: The bidder or the OEM of the offered products must have ISO 9001 certification. 5. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. The bidder must possess a valid UDYAM Registration Certificate issued by the competent authority, Government of India, and the same shall be submitted along with the bid. 2.The bidder shall submit a valid Warranty Certificate for the offered UPS system and batteri es. 3. The bidder shall submit an OEM-issued Manufacturer Authorization Form (MAF), specificall

y mentioning the present tender reference, along with the technical bid. 4. The bidder should have prior experience in supplying similar equipment to Government D epartments, Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs), or Autonomous Bodies within the preceding three years. Supporting purchase orders or contract documents must be enclosed. 5. All expenses towards transportation, delivery, unloading, installation, commissioning, test ing, demonstration, and end-user training shall be borne entirely by the supplier without clai ming any additional charges from the purchaser. 6. The UPS and batteries offered against this tender must be in original factory-sealed condi tion and completely unused. Repaired, refurbished, reconditioned, or previously unsealed e quipment will be treated as non-compliant. 7. The bidder shall maintain a GeM Seller Rating of not less than 4 on the last date prescribe d for bid submission. 8. The bidder must submit audited financial records comprising the Balance Sheet, Profit an d Loss Statement, and Auditor's Report, together with the relevant Income Tax Returns for F Y 2022–23, 2023–24, 2024–25, and 2025–26. Unaudited or provisional financial records shall not be considered. 9.The bidder shall submit an OEM-certified Technical Compliance Certificate confirming that the offered UPS system and batteries comply with the technical specifications and requirem ents mentioned in the tender document. 10. The supplier shall ensure that any complaint relating to the UPS or battery system is atte nded to within four (4) hours and the reported fault is resolved within twenty-four (24) hours . In case the issue remains unresolved, a standby UPS of equivalent or greater capacity, incl uding battery backup, shall be arranged free of cost until the original system is restored. An undertaking accepting these conditions must accompany the bid. 11. The bidder shall provide a signed declaration stating that the firm has not been blacklist ed, suspended, or debarred by any Central Government, State Government, PSU, or other G overnment Agency during the last Three years. 12. Payment shall be made strictly after completion of supply, installation, and successful co mmissioning. No advance or upfront payment shall be entertained. The full admissible paym ent shall be released against a valid GST invoice, subject to deduction of the applicable buy back amount towards the old/obsolete equipment. 13. The purchaser shall be entitled to cross-verify all certificates, declarations, credentials, a nd supporting documents furnished by the bidder with the concerned issuing authorities or t he respective OEM whenever required during the tender evaluation or execution process. 14. Any submission of forged, manipulated, falsified, or misleading certificates or records sh all lead to immediate disqualification of the bid and may result in further legal proceedings a s deemed appropriate by the purchaser. .
